### Retractable Skates Alternate Movement
All anthrodrones feature **Retractable Skates** [BS p. 47]:
* **Activation**: Extending or retracting skates takes a **Minor Action**.
* **Movement Rules**: Uses metahuman movement rules: **Walking 10m/rnd**, **Sprinting 30m/rnd**, **+2m per net hit** on Sprinting tests.

## Standardized Drone Action Pools

| Drone Action / Test | Base Skill & Attributes | Applied Modifiers Math | Final Dice Pool |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **Drone Piloting / Maneuvering** | Maneuvering (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sleaze (`{python} ACTIVE_S`) = **`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_S`d6** | Base (`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_S`) + Diagnosis (+`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS - 1`) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_S + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS - 1`d6** |
| **Drone Weapon Attack (Gunnery)** | Targeting (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Data Processing (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) = **`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_D`d6** | Base (`{python} ACTIVE_D * 2`) + Teamwork (+`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D * 2 + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`d6** |
| **Drone Evasion (Defense Test)** | Evasion (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sleaze (`{python} ACTIVE_S`) = **`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_S`d6** | Base (`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_S`) + Teamwork (+`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + ACTIVE_S + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`d6** |
| **Drone Perception Test** | Clearsight (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sensor | Base (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sensor Upgrade (+1) + Teamwork (+`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D +1 + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` + Sensor d6** |
| **Drone Stealth Test** | Stealth (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Data Processing (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) = **`{python} ACTIVE_D * 2`d6** | Base (`{python} ACTIVE_D * 2`) + Tactical Soft Sneak-Sneak (+2) + Teamwork (+`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D * 2 + 2 + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`d6** |

Reiko can also operate drones using the *Override* Sprite Power [SR6H p. 194], which allows her to replace the drone's pilot with herself (acting as a sprite with a Level equal to her Resonance). Because this is now a test involving her Resonance pool, her Resonance Focus applies [HnS p. 71].

| Drone Action / Test | Base Skill & Attributes | Applied Modifiers Math | Final Dice Pool |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **Perception** | Clearsight (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sensor | +1 Sensor Upgrade, +`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` Teamwork (Sprite Symbiosis) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + 1 + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` + Sensor d6** |
| **Evasion** | Evasion (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Pilot (`{python} RESONANCE`) | +4 Resonance Focus, +`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` Teamwork (Sprite Symbiosis) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + RESONANCE + 4 + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS`d6** |
| **Piloting** | Maneuvering (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Pilot (`{python} RESONANCE`) | +4 Resonance Focus, +3 Diagnostics | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + RESONANCE + 7`d6** |
| **Stealth** | Stealth `{python} ACTIVE_D` + Pilot (`{python} RESONANCE`) | +4 Resonance Focus, +`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` Teamwork + Tactical Soft Sneak-Sneak (+2) | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + RESONANCE + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS + 6`d6** |
| **Weapons** | Targeting (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sensor | Base (`{python} ACTIVE_D`) + Sensor Upgrade (+1) +`{python} SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` Teamwork | **`{python} ACTIVE_D + 1 + SPRITE_SYMBIOSIS` + Sensor d6** |

## Controlling Drones Protocols & Rules

AI characters with **Pilot Origins** [HnS p. 119] operate drones using two distinct methods:

### 1. Jumped-In Operation (Rigging)
* **Control Rig Bonus**: Pilot Origins grants control rig benefits [HnS p. 119].
* **Mental Attribute Substitution**: Jumped-in rigger uses mental attributes instead of physical ones [SR6 Core p. 198]:
  * Piloting: **Piloting + Intuition**
  * Gunnery: **Firearms + Logic**
  * Defense: **Intuition + Willpower**

### 2. Remote Control / Un-jumped Operation {#matrix-equivalent-attributes}
* **Remote Tests** [SR6H p. 180]
  * AR: normal physical attribute
  * VR: substitute appropriate mental attribute (Body = Willpower, Agility = Logic, Reaction = Intuition, Strength = Charisma).
* **Matrix Equivalent Attributes**: When controlling drones remotely via AR using Control Device, a Pilot Origin AI must use their "physical attributes" (which map to ASDF) [HnS p. 118]:
  * Body → Firewall (`{python} ACTIVE_F`)
  * Agility → Data Processing (`{python} ACTIVE_D`)
  * Reaction → Sleaze (`{python} ACTIVE_S`)
  * Strength → Attack (`{python} ACTIVE_A`)

## Sensor Locks

* **Establishing**: Electronics + Logic (or Sensor + Clearsight) vs. Reaction + Piloting (or Pilot + Evasion) (Major Action).
* **Locked On Status**: Target cannot spend Edge while defending against attacks originating from the vehicle that established lock. Lasts until Cover IV is achieved or ended by Break Sensor Lock.
* **Break Sensor Lock**: Reaction + Piloting (or Intuition + Reaction) vs. Electronics + Intuition (or Clearsight + Sensor) (Major Action).
